'''Almurat Mor''' is the name given to a [[Seanchan]] [[Seekers for Truth|Seeker for Truth]]. 

== Appearance ==
He is middle-aged and slender. He has pale yellow hair and blue eyes. He has a tattoo of the raven and a tower on each shoulder.

== Activities ==
He is the nameless Seeker who questions [[Egeanin Tamarath]] in [[Tanchico]] about her search of the lost ''[[sul'dam]]'' from [[Falme]]. She hides and protects [[Bethamin]] to prevent the Blood from killing her.{{ref/book|4|38}} He follows Egeanin, when she travels to meet up with [[Nynaeve al'Meara]] and [[Elayne Trakand]].{{ref/book|4|46}} He attacks [[Thomdril Merrilin]] and is knocked unconscious when [[Juilin]] and [[Bayle Domon]] arrive.{{ref/book|4|52}}

He then later appears in [[Ebou Dar]] and instructs the ''sul'dam'' Bethamin to renew her friendship with Egeanin in order to spy on her.

When he introduces himself to [[Furyk Karede]], he gives his name.{{ref/book|10|4}} He formulates a theory on the disappearance of [[Tuon Athaem Kore Paendrag]], Egeanin, Thom, [[Matrim Cauthon]] and a number of missing ''[[damane]]'' and ''sul'dam'' linking it all to [[Suroth Sabelle Meldarath]].
